purpose: six original four-panel storyboards, cut into 24 video shots
prompts: Create ONE production storyboard sheet, landscape 16:9, highest practical resolution. EXACT 2 by 2 GRID of FOUR EQUAL 16:9 cinematic panels, edge to edge, no gutters, no border, no text anywhere, no speech bubbles, no lettering, no logos. This will be cut into 4 standalone video shots, so no elements cross the exact central horizontal or vertical boundary. Reference image 1 is the approved character AND illustration style. Match elegant semi-realistic Korean webtoon art: fine ink, hand-painted detailed realistic interiors, nuanced expressive faces, warm amber light against rainy navy windows, premium mature emotional drama, not flat cartoon. Seoyun is the SAME 42-year-old Korean woman in every shot: chin-length slightly wavy chestnut bob, side part, ivory blouse, delicate gold pendant and earrings, believable mature adult subtle eye lines, restrained expressions. Her apartment: wooden dining table, cream lamp on left, rainy large window behind, tiny white birthday cake with ONE unlit candle, empty chair opposite. No smartphone gibberish, screens blank or facing away. No unnecessary crowds, not photorealistic photos. EPISODE ONE, BOARD A. TOP LEFT: cinematic medium closeup, Seoyun at the apartment table holding phone to ear giving a small brave smile. TOP RIGHT: reverse wide view, Seoyun alone at that table after the call, phone lowered, untouched small birthday cake, empty opposite chair emphasized. BOTTOM LEFT: earlier that day, Seoyun same blouse in realistic daytime design office leaning over laptop, stacks of printouts and coworkers softly blurred far behind, weary obliging expression. BOTTOM RIGHT: evening bakery counter, Seoyun still ivory blouse with beige coat over it, selecting a tiny white cake, paper takeaway box, bittersweet hesitant smile. Make composition human and full of subtle dramatic detail.
